styles.base: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged hanji paper texture. Bright, clear, high contrast, faces large and readable. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.sil: Korean minhwa ink-wash painting on hanji paper mixed with bold acrylic painting in the style of a sunset landscape: sky of layered flat gray and silver clouds with ribbons of gold, orange and red glowing between them, figures and trees as solid black silhouettes, blue-violet shadows. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.web: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style, matching the style of the reference image: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged cream hanji paper. Bright and clear, faces large and readable. No text, no letters anywhere.

characters.MYEONGBO: a blind man in his fifties, eyes always closed, topknot, plain hemp jacket and gray trousers, a long bamboo staff
characters.MOTHER: a woman in a pale undyed hemp jeogori and a charcoal gray skirt, no red anywhere, in her thirties, eyes open, plain low bun, poor and drab
characters.CHILD: a little boy about five, round face, short topknot, pale blue hemp jacket and white trousers, never a girl
characters.HAEGEUM: a Korean haegeum: a fist sized round bamboo soundbox at the bottom, a short straight neck with two pegs jutting sideways near the top, two strings and a slim bow
characters.BOYGROWN: a boy about ten, short topknot, pale blue hemp jacket and white trousers, clearly older than a toddler

scenes.S01: Many village people in hemp clothes wading in a shallow river and walking along its banks with long poles, searching the water, their faces grim. Seen from a distance, no large faces. Daylight, low hills behind, nothing written.
scenes.S02: MYEONGBO crouching on a wooded hillside and striking the ground with his bamboo staff, head tilted to listen, a cloth wrapped bundle slung on his back. Behind him several villagers stand watching with doubtful faces. Daylight.
scenes.S05: A close view from the chest up, filling the frame: MYEONGBO sitting on a wooden veranda, eyes closed, his face calm and absorbed, both arms lowered toward an instrument that is out of frame below. Only his hands and forearms show. Nobody else, daylight.
scenes.S06: A close view from the chest up: MYEONGBO at the edge of a wedding courtyard, eyes closed, absorbed, both arms lowered toward an instrument out of frame below. Behind him guests at tables talk and laugh without looking at him. Daylight.
scenes.S07: Only one person in the picture: MYEONGBO walking a village lane with his eyes closed, tapping the ground ahead with his staff, a cloth wrapped bundle slung on his back. Nobody else, daylight, low walls.
scenes.S08: Exactly two people in a village lane: MYEONGBO standing with his eyes closed and his head slightly tilted, and a farming man in his forties with a topknot and a full hemp jacket, carrying a heavy bundle of firewood on his back, stopping in front of him with a surprised face. No women. Daylight.
scenes.S09: [SIL] Sunset over a hill path, a lone man with a staff and a cloth bundle on his back walking as a black silhouette, layered gray and silver clouds with ribbons of gold behind him.
scenes.S10: A farmyard of bare earth and low grass filling the frame edge to edge: in the middle CHILD squats low, gathering pebbles with both hands. A straw basket and a wooden bucket nearby. Nobody else, daylight, no writing.
scenes.S11: Only one person in the picture: MOTHER standing in an empty farmyard with both hands over her mouth, looking around in panic, a hoe dropped at her feet. A few ripe old pumpkins lie by the fence, no tomatoes and no red fruit. Nobody else, daylight.
scenes.S12: A group of village men holding torches searching a dark village lane at night, looking behind walls and under a cart, their faces tense. Night, no large faces, nothing written.
scenes.S13: Village men wading in a shallow river with long poles, probing the water, women standing on the bank watching with worried faces. Daylight, seen from a distance, nothing written.
scenes.S14: Exactly two people on a river bank: MOTHER sitting collapsed on the sand with her face in her hands, and an older village man in a hemp jacket standing beside her looking down with a heavy face. The wide river behind them. Daylight.
scenes.S16: Only one person in the picture: MYEONGBO standing still on a dark path at night with his eyes closed and his face turned toward a wooded hillside, his staff held up off the ground, listening hard. Deep blue night, nobody else.
scenes.S17: A close view filling the frame: MYEONGBO with his eyes closed and his head tilted, his ear turned toward the side, his weathered face intent, a dark wooded hillside blurred behind him. Nobody else, nothing written.
scenes.S18: Only one person in the picture: MYEONGBO walking into a village yard with his staff and a cloth wrapped bundle slung on his back, his eyes closed, his face urgent. Daylight, thatched roofs behind. Nobody else.
scenes.S19: MYEONGBO standing in the middle of a village yard with his eyes closed and his staff in one hand, surrounded by six villagers who look at him with doubtful and annoyed faces. Daylight, nothing written.
scenes.S20: Four village men turning away from the yard with dismissive faces and waving hands, walking off in different directions, mouths closed. Daylight, nobody else in front.
scenes.S21: Exactly two people in an empty yard: MOTHER gripping a sleeve with both hands and looking up with desperate eyes at MYEONGBO, who stands still. Daylight, nobody else.
scenes.S23: Exactly two people and nobody else, climbing a wooded hillside: MYEONGBO in front tapping the ground with his staff, eyes closed, and MOTHER following behind him. Daylight.
scenes.S24: Only one person in the picture, seen at half length: MYEONGBO crouching on a wooded slope and striking the ground with his bamboo staff, his eyes closed and his head tilted to listen. Fallen leaves and undergrowth around him. Nobody else.
scenes.S25: Exactly two people and nobody else on a wooded slope: MYEONGBO frozen with his staff raised, eyes closed, and MOTHER just behind him with a hand over her mouth. Undergrowth ahead. Daylight.
scenes.S26: Exactly two people and nobody else on a wooded hillside: MOTHER and MYEONGBO pulling undergrowth away with their bare hands, uncovering the dark round mouth of an old pit. Daylight.
scenes.S27: Two people kneeling at a dark hole on a hillside: MOTHER leaning over the opening calling down into it, MYEONGBO beside her, eyes closed, one hand on the ground. Daylight.
scenes.S28: A close view: MYEONGBO lying flat on the ground with the side of his face pressed to the edge of a dark hole, his eyes closed, listening with his whole body. Blurred hillside behind. Nobody else.
scenes.S30: A group of village men running up a wooded hillside path carrying coils of rope and a ladder, their faces urgent. Daylight, seen from a distance, no large faces.
scenes.S31: On a hillside beside a dark pit: one village man kneels on the ground holding CHILD limp in both arms, just pulled out, the boy's head on his shoulder and his feet touching the ground. Two other men stand behind holding a taut rope. Daylight.
scenes.S32: MOTHER kneeling on a hillside and holding CHILD tightly against her chest, crying with her eyes shut, the boy arms around her neck. A few villagers stand well back. Daylight.
scenes.S33: Several villagers bowing deeply on a hillside toward MYEONGBO, who raises both hands in a flustered gesture. Daylight.
scenes.S34: Exactly two people at a house gate: a village elder holding out a cloth pouch with both hands, and MYEONGBO stepping back with one palm raised, his eyes closed. Daylight, nobody else.
scenes.S35: MYEONGBO seen from the chest up on a wooden veranda, eyes closed, listening, his hands resting in his lap with nothing in them, and three villagers standing before him talking earnestly, one pointing away toward the fields. Daylight.
scenes.S36: Exactly two people walking a village lane: MYEONGBO with his eyes closed and a cloth wrapped bundle on his back, and BOYGROWN beside him holding his hand and looking up at him. Daylight, low walls. Nobody else.
scenes.S37: [SIL] Sunset over a village road, a tall man with a cloth bundle on his back and a boy of about ten walking side by side as black silhouettes, layered silver clouds and a band of gold light behind them.
